svg.title: A composed four-line specimen
svg.desc: On each and every page of white, / In lines both smooth and graceful, / The pen may leave while in its flight, / Thoughts of the truly grateful.. Clean vector study from Lessons in Ornamental Penmanship, printed page 64. Printed page65 credits the ten preceding plates to E. A. Lupfer. Paper texture removed; source letter construction retained.
